nusmp.skill.book_rock.description: The grimoire of Rock Magic: raw, jagged crag and boulder. Its pages throw boulders, break the ground into crags, drop rock on a field, call the Boulder Titan and wrap you in boulder armour. Hold the grimoire, hold the skill key to chant, release to cast.
nusmp.page.book_rock.attribute_bolt: Rock Bolt - a boulder is torn loose and thrown along your line of sight; it arcs a little, bursts on the first foe or block and hurts everything round the burst.
nusmp.page.book_rock.attribute_cut: Crags erupt one after another along your line of sight, hitting and lifting what stands on them.
nusmp.page.book_rock.attribute_field: A rockfall laid at the aimed point: stones keep dropping on everything inside, slowing and shoving it.
nusmp.page.book_rock.attribute_domain: A quake round you: a great burst that hurls back and weakens everything near, and forges the boulder armour for a few seconds.
nusmp.page.book_rock.attribute_guard: Boulder armour: heavy rock gathers over your body piece by piece for nine seconds, with Resistance II, thorns and a share of your aura spent; rocks orbit you. It shatters out when it ends.
nusmp.page.book_rock.boulder_titan: The Boulder Titan - a hunched crag giant rises at your side with a shock where it stands. It stomps the nearest foe, and now and then roars: everything close is thrown back and weakened (hard control, shared lock).
nusmp.page.book_rock.boulder_barrage: Three boulders thrown in a fan; each bursts where it lands.
